motion.name: ease-apple-fluid
motion.purpose: Apple fluid curve for entrance and physical scale transitions.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Standard modal and card transition duration.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with instant active scale feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1f6f78; color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1.5px); background: #15535a; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96) translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); transition-duration: 100ms; }

components.name: Dashboard Card
components.description: Interactive card widget with bottom accent border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; padding: 25px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06); border-bottom: 4px solid #1f6f78; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.10); } .ds-card:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: The Al-Hidayet Mission design language pairs structured institutional authority with warm, accessible clarity.
dos: Do apply scale(0.97) on pointer-down active states
donts: Don't use sluggish ease-in animation curves
